app.title: Upcycle Compass
app.tagline: Go / No-go / Test-first for by-product proteins
app.needInput: Choose a preset or fill the form first.
app.safetyEnglish: Safety wording (verdict labels, gate states, disclaimers) stays in English until a Hindi-reading reviewer has checked it.

num.transferredLong: Evidence transferred from another material (α = {{alpha}}): range widened

input.summary: Pick a preset or describe your batch. Every field you leave empty uses a labelled dataset default.
input.equipment: Available equipment (leave all unticked if not known)
input.batchHint: Values you enter are labelled measured (M). Enter them on the material as received.
input.completenessText: {{filled}} of {{total}} dataset values filled; {{ab}} graded A/B

verdict.summary: The decision for this batch and use, with how sure the engine is and why.
verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.disclaimer: Decision support only. Not a regulatory approval. Confirm FSSAI classification and limits.

diagnosis.summary: Which compounds hold this by-product back for this use, and how far over the limit they are.
diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.chartTitle: Level ÷ application tolerance (1 = at the limit)

chains.summary: Candidate treatment chains, ranked by the chance of meeting your spec. Tap a row for details.
chains.title: Treatment chains
chains.none: No chains: a safety gate failed, so chains are not ranked.
chains.costMissing: Cost components missing (cost is a lower bound)
chains.paretoTitle: Pareto view: cost vs protein retained (viable chains)
chains.paretoSummary: {{n}} viable chains; {{front}} on the Pareto front (outlined). Dot size = P(spec); bars = P10–P90.
chains.paretoNone: No viable chain has a computable cost, so the Pareto chart is not shown.

cost.summary: Our cost per kg protein for the top chain against imported pea isolate, landed in India.
cost.title: Cost vs imported pea isolate
cost.lowerBound: Lower bound: some cost components have no data yet
cost.notComputable: Our cost is not computable: the by-product price is missing. Enter it on the Input screen.
cost.chartSummary: Ours {{ours}} vs pea {{pea}} per kg protein (P50).

next.summary: The one test worth buying first, how ready the decision is, and a validation plan.
next.title: Next step
next.noTest: No measurement is worth buying: decide now.
next.upperBound: upper bound (assay CV unknown, perfect test assumed)
next.costMissing: not in the dataset yet: buy it if a quote is below {{evsi}}
next.evppiTitle: Which uncertainty matters most (EVPPI, ₹ per decision)
next.evppiSummary: Top driver: {{label}}. Price inputs rank low when they barely change the decision.
next.utility: Decision assumptions (shown so you can challenge them)
next.campaign: Decision volume (one pilot campaign of cake)
next.eNow: Expected value of the best option now
next.notAvailable: Value of information is not computable: our cost needs the by-product price. Enter it on the Input screen.

state.errorSnapshot: Could not analyse. Showing demo snapshot.

footer.disclaimer: Decision support only. Not a regulatory approval. Confirm FSSAI classification and limits.
footer.poc: Proof of concept. Not a substitute for laboratory validation.
footer.privacy: No accounts and no personal data. Only your language choice is stored in this browser.

ai.badgeAi: AI-written summary; numbers checked against the engine
ai.describeHint: For example: Groundnut cake from Rajkot, about 48% protein, for a protein drink, no solvents. Do not include personal details.
ai.filled: Filled by {{provider}}. Check the highlighted fields, then press Analyse.
ai.failed: Could not read this automatically; please fill the form.
ai.badgeTranslated: Machine-written Hindi; numbers checked against the engine

lab.title: Enter your lab result
lab.hint: One measured value updates the analysis (Bayesian update); you see before and after.
lab.fractionHint: This is a fraction: enter 0–1 (e.g. 0.62 for 62%).

voice.requesting: Allow the microphone in your browser…
voice.listening: Listening… press Stop when you are done.
voice.ready: Transcript ready: check and edit it, then press Fill the form.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, or type instead.
voice.noSpeech: No speech was heard. Try again or type instead.
voice.network: The browser's speech service could not be reached. Try again or type instead.
voice.privacy: Your browser's speech service processes the audio (Chrome: Google; Safari: Apple). Do not say personal details.
